title: A sequence of point blowups with constant residue field and a fixed exceptional equation comes from a nonsingular arc
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter resolve.tex (Resolution of Surfaces)

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a sequence of blowups at closed points with constant residue field along the sequence and with a fixed element defining the exceptional divisor at every step is obtained from a nonsingular arc (statement lines 2802-2819). The proof (proof lines 2821-2891) estimates the powers of the distinguished element, rewrites generators of the maximal ideals along the sequence to compare successive kernels whose quotient lengths are computed by induction, and takes the limit to produce a complete discrete valuation ring through which the sequence factors. H3: an original length computation with a limit construction, written out in full.
